status: Implemented; build, default and Worker validation passed
contract: SpillAdapter optionally supplies readOwned(ref, budget), admitting output storage before allocation and returning an independent OwnedMemory handle. MemorySpillAdapter implements it using exact byteLength plus view charge before copying. Top-k and sort restore select the capability automatically. Returned read ownership is adopted into the restore scope and overlaps parsed source/detachment. Late completion after cancellation releases the independent owner when scope adoption rejects.

cases: Exact byte/view capacity succeeds; one byte short rejects
Sibling reservation and stored spill bytes survive read denial
Returned read copy is independent of stored data
Both stateful operators retain a pending owned read through cancellation and release after settlement

boundaries: Legacy custom adapters without readOwned use their existing read contract; pre-allocation admission is not guaranteed for those adapters.
Memory adapter backing storage/write copies are governed by its maxBytes limit, not by read ownership.
Remote adapters must implement pre-allocation admission themselves; an in-memory read test does not establish remote transport buffering bounds.
Legacy aggregate restore has not yet adopted this capability.
